public_detail: The vendor is currently working on the fob system installing new memory equipment for each door. As they work through the installation, each door will have a period of time that it will be down. These outages will last approximately one hour per door. They will only be working on one door at a time, so if a door is not working, please try another one. If you have any questions, please contact the office.
